scenes.caption: Reversing the displayed options changes the selected semantic answer.

scenes.name: order-probabilities

scenes.caption: A and B use one probability scale. Compare the answer with its reference.

scenes.caption: One call versus five calls; one is shared. The union is five, not six.

scenes.name: averaging-reference

scenes.caption: This selected example changes from correct to incorrect after averaging.

scenes.name: source-trace
scenes.title: 3 / TRACE THE EVIDENCE
scenes.caption: Expand original members, one-based JSONL lines, mappings, and hashes.

scenes.name: export
scenes.title: EXPORT EXACT COMPARISON JSON
scenes.caption: Download preserves probabilities and source definitions; no new inference.

scenes.name: score
scenes.title: 4 / SEPARATE EXPECTATION FROM THE MODE
scenes.caption: The expected stage differs from the most likely stage in both conditions.

scenes.name: collapse-comparison
scenes.title: 5 / CHECK THE FULL PANEL
scenes.caption: A single item cannot establish collapse. Inspect every retained item.

scenes.name: full-panel
scenes.title: FULL-PANEL FREQUENCIES AND SCORE RANGE
scenes.caption: These 200-item counts remain independent of the selected source item.

scenes.name: next-item-same-panel
scenes.title: MOVE TO ANOTHER ITEM
scenes.caption: The selected item changes; full-panel frequencies retain the same scope.

scenes.name: scope
scenes.title: KNOW WHAT THE RECORDS SUPPORT
scenes.caption: Examples are outcome-selected; interface checks are not a user study.

scenes.title: Try it without downloading a model.

scope: Recorded interactions with frozen data, plus 16 seconds of previously recorded local inference. Neither human evaluation nor a fresh model run. Actual UI pixels are scaled uniformly; caption strip is outside the Explorer viewport. Archival excerpt only replaces its original caption strip.
selection: Four pre-existing deterministic outcome-selected illustrations; not representative sampling. See docs/explorer/DATA.md.
